column3: Thieves and bandits are plural instead of singular thief and band.
“Needs not” expresses the baker’s stopping as lack of need.
“Joins hands” renders stretching out his hand with mockers; “him” is supplied as the object of mockery.
“Their anger smolders” replaces their baker sleeps.
“When I hear them flocking together” replaces according to the report to their assembly.
“The Most High” identifies the height; cursing renders the indignation of their tongue.
